components.title: AirPlay network test service
components.description: For the app AirPlay Test: announces a test AirPlay receiver over mDNS and notes whether an iPhone finds and reaches it (on tcp 7300: the car's CarPlay holds 7000). Opens the firewall for that port and mDNS only while a test runs. Not a receiver: nothing is streamed.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: AirPlay Test
components.description: Network test for a future AirPlay receiver: can an iPhone find and reach the head unit? Announces a test receiver and shows what the iPhone does. Needs the AirPlay network test service.
components.author: aurelmarius
